stem: Why did slavery become a widespread practice in the United States during the early nineteenth century?

options.label: F
options.text: The system of indentured servitude was banned.

options.label: G
options.text: The need for agricultural labor increased as a result of expanded cotton production.

options.label: H
options.text: Improved transportation systems made it easier for workers to migrate.

options.label: J
options.text: Advancements in technology led to the need for skilled workers.
